name: io.github.igorolv/sonar-mcp-server
title: Sonar MCP Server
description: Read-only SonarQube Community Build access for AI agents: issues, hotspots, rules, code snippets

environmentVariables.name: SONAR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SonarQube instance, e.g. https://sonar.example.com

environmentVariables.name: SONAR_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SonarQube user token (My Account -> Security -> Generate Tokens)

environmentVariables.name: SONAR_DEFAULT_PROJECT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Project key used when a tool call does not name one
